scope: Facts are relative to the exact preprocessed review prefix visible to both models, not independently verified product facts. Labels were prepared before final predictions. Sparse reviews may supply only use or sentiment details.

rubric.coverage: For each of two preselected facts, preserved means the summary explicitly states the complete fact or an equivalent paraphrase. A broader positive/negative sentiment alone does not preserve a specific attribute. Missing, partial, contradicted, or unclear facts score zero.
rubric.claims: Split each summary into atomic claims. Label supported, unsupported, contradicted, or uncertain against visible source only. Supported must quote an exact evidence span. Unsupported means no source support; contradicted means explicit source conflict. Ambiguous wording is uncertain. Reviewer sentiment can support equivalent sentiment, but cannot establish a specific property or universal claim.
rubric.denominators: 48 selected facts per system; 24 summaries per system. Fully supported requires at least one claim and every claim supported. Empty output cannot be fully supported. Report both coverage and support separately; generic but supported outputs can have zero detail coverage.
rubric.review_design: Single agent-authored, non-independent, non-blind review. No model or decoding changes after the final-test lock. No external factuality accuracy claim.
